sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, and face an Alsager side anchored at the bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and a run of five losses in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to maintain their title challenge after recent mixed form. AFC Bridgnorth, third and among the in-form teams, host Eccleshall in a meeting of high-placed sides—Bridgnorth recently bounced back from a loss with a win, while Eccleshall sit fifth but have struggled with inconsistency. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth, travel to Wednesfield Community in a fixture between closely-ranked teams. Bilston Town, sixth and unbeaten in recent outings, face Foley Meir at home. Barnton entertain Shawbury United, with the hosts showing recent form while visitors struggle badly (five losses in six). New Mills host Market Drayton Town, with both teams occupying mid-to-lower positions and seeking wins. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement-area clash between two of the division's weakest performers. Crewe, struggling near the foot of the table, travel to Allscott Heath in a match involving sides with limited recent success. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with Widnes in particular desperately seeking points after winless form.
